s.note: Crimped shortcrust pasties of diced beef, potato, swede and onion with plenty of black pepper
s.how: Finely dice 350g beef skirt steak, 1 potato, 150g swede and 1 onion and season hard with salt and pepper. Cut 4 rounds from 3 sheets shortcrust pastry, pile on the filling, dot with 20g butter, fold and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 170C for 30 minutes. Rest 5 minutes.

s.note: Crisp sweet corn and spring onion fritters with coriander, served with lime sour cream
s.how: Cut the kernels from 3 corn cobs. Whisk 1 egg, 80ml milk, 75g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt, then fold in the corn, 2 sliced spring onions and a handful of chopped coriander. Fry spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve with 125g sour cream mixed with the zest and juice of 1 lime.

m.n: Jackson's Star never-sunrise beef and barley stew
m.note: Slow-braised beef chuck with carrot, celery and pearl barley in a thick gravy, with crusty bread
m.how: Toss 800g diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 2 garlic cloves, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, add 1.2 litres beef stock, 2 bay leaves and 1 tsp dried thyme and simmer covered for 1 hour. Add 100g pearl barley and simmer 40 minutes more. Season, scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Buttery lemon loaf soaked in a crunchy lemon sugar drizzle while it is still warm
w.how: Cream 175g butter and 175g caster sugar, beat in 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in 175g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp milk. Bake in a lined loaf tin at 180C for 45 minutes. Mix the juice of 3 lemons with 100g caster sugar, prick the hot cake all over and pour the drizzle on. Cool in the tin.

d.note: Lime syrup blended with ice into a slushie, topped with soda water and fresh mint
d.how: Simmer 100g caster sugar in 125ml water until dissolved and cool. Blend with the juice of 4 limes and 3 cups ice until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, top with a splash of soda water and a mint sprig.
